items.description: CLI proxy that reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev commands. Single Rust binary, zero dependencies
A modern file manager that helps users organize their files and folders.
n³ The unorthodox terminal file manager
The world's best AI personal assistant for email. Open source app to help you reach inbox zero fast.
Free, open-source tiling window manager for Apple Silicon Macs, with Niri-style scrolling containers and Hyprland-style Dwindle BSP.
A macOS clipboard workbench: text and pictures that land on the clipboard leave usable. 喵喵剪贴板：macOS 上的剪贴板工作台，文字和图片进了剪贴板就变成能直接用的样子。

iPad-first, open-source iOS AI Agent optimized for iOS/iPadOS, with native iPhone support and Android alpha. On-device Linux, terminal, Python/Node.js, Git and web previews; BYOK AI, Notes, Office, Canvas, CAD/3D, voice, Skill Hub and supported local models on iOS. 开源设备端 AI 智能体工作台。
The official Mechvibes app: mechanical keyboard and mouse sounds for every keystroke and click, on Windows, macOS and Linux. Built with Rust and Dioxus.
Wishes in, PRs out. CLI agent that interviews you, plans the work, dispatches parallel agents in isolated worktrees, and reviews code before you see it.

Termul is Terminal Ultimate Manager a cross-platform desktop terminal manager built with Tauri and React. Organize terminals by workspace with persistent sessions, multiple shell, split panes, embedded browser tabs, and a built-in code & markdown editor.
Cross-runtime skills for Claude Code, Codex, and multi-agent workflows.
Your tasks, your server. An open-source, local-first task manager you can host yourself. Everything you expect from a commercial task app, without the subscription or the lock-in.

Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.

Your work, already underway. A personal AI assistant for your job: mail, chats and tickets become tasks, the agents you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) do the work, and nothing goes out until you approve. Open source, runs on your machine.

Open-source Arc-style browser built on Chromium: sidebar with vertical tabs, Spaces, folders, pinned tabs, a command bar, one-click import from Arc. macOS and Windows (Linux is coming soon). No telemetry.
